governing_outcome: UAOS should be able to discover useful missing capabilities before incidents and carry any justified improvement through one evidence-traced governed transaction without relying on repeated user reminders or disconnected helper-local lifecycle steps.

supported_contributing_causes.evidence: Maintenance timing/admission, proposal transition, promotion gating and self-change orchestration were split across opportunistic.py, maintenance.py, lifecycle.py, gates.py and manual drill composition; no canonical executable owned discovery through post-promotion observation.
ChangeProposal previously required a failure_class_id or evaluated knowledge id and could not represent a newly discovered latent capability gap as its own admitted origin.

A direct-main maintenance write and repeated inherited-progress omission occurred in native ChatGPT despite repository policy/runtime gates, demonstrating that native response/tool paths are not physically mediated by those gates.
The assistant twice stopped after diagnosis/recording of repairable gaps until the user explicitly demanded continued repair, despite problem-to-action policy already existing.

architecture_candidates.reason: Scheduling the existing fragments would automate a fragmented lifecycle and would not make capability gaps first-class or prevent stage orphaning.
Repeated cognition/progress/mutation/action-closure failures show that local guards do not establish one owner for the full evolution transaction.

Independent production evidence still supports authority routing, continuity, domain health and other unrelated control surfaces; full replacement would widen the failure surface without causal evidence.
A single transaction owner directly closes the evidenced ownership/origin gaps while reusing lower-level helper mechanisms and existing promotion/action authority.

method_evidence: NIST AI RMF ongoing monitoring and periodic review supports non-incident-only review.
ISO/IEC 42001 continual-improvement framing supports recurrent Plan-Do-Check-Act style adaptation rather than one-off correction.
SEI ATAM supports evaluating architecture against goals, scenarios, risks and tradeoffs rather than preserving familiar structure.

User-provided Felix Rieseberg height/breadth/depth methodology was treated as an evaluation candidate: height -> governing outcome; breadth -> multi-lens outside-in discovery; depth -> raw evidence, professional methods/tools, novelty probes and external judge. Its stretch-target tactic was bounded by feasibility evidence rather than model insistence.
assurance_boundary: The repository can enforce EvolutionTransaction in controlled paths that invoke it. Native ChatGPT has no verified repository-controlled pre-send or pre-tool hook. A periodic proactive trigger exists only when a real host scheduler/ChatGPT Automation is configured; kernel policy alone does not create background execution.
next_action: Freeze candidate semantics after task/index synchronization, require green final-head CI and live integration, then promote through controlled merge, production reread and post-promotion closure. Only after production promotion configure a real ChatGPT Automation for periodic proactive capability review.
